method.daySource: fallbackDay UTC dates starting 2026-01-01; sample seed is day offset
method.engine: Actual createRun, generateMap and act reducers transpiled from git baseline/current source; no injected cards, HP, damage, relics or altered state.

policies.score-greedy: Select score powers/Mult rewards; favor scoring routes, block and delay lethal attacks while HP >16 through turn 24, then try to win. Raw visual score drives scoring choices under both rules.
policies.survival: Value preventing incoming damage and healing, choose recovery/treasure routes and efficient combat cards.
policies.random: Seeded uniform playable-card choices with 8% chance to end turn; uniform route/reward/event choices; deterministic canonical target and choice-card options; buys affordable useful cards.
policies.clear-focused: Value damage, lethal plays, efficient block and enemy debuffs; choose recovery/treasure routes, damage upgrades and useful rewards.

method.visibility: Bots inspect current hand, public intents, revealed map and legal Oracle draw choices; no hidden draw inspection.

guards.behavior: Bots legally end their turn after 40 plays to bound zero-cost draw/energy loops. The run action/turn guards record intervention and legally abandon; these are harness runtime limits, not scoring rules.

method.comparison: Same date seeds and policy source before/after. Scoring-only changes should preserve trajectories. Bots are diagnostics, not estimates of human win rate.
method.quantiles: Sorted empirical order statistic at floor((n-1)*q); null for empty samples.
